search_window.basis: From completed_at in the latest prior verified Food Line Source Watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. Include only new evidence/announcements since this timestamp; fresh crawl/index dates alone do not qualify.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall. Nationwide production collector and editorial gates remain authoritative.

coverage_notes.observation: Twelve targeted searches over four high-value classes identified no independently verifiable new U.S. incident announced after the 12:47:40 PST preceding heartbeat. Surfaced results primarily contained historical 2025 SNAP-shutdown material, older pantry closures and preannounced SNAP eligibility changes effective November 1, 2026. No fresh provider/agency distribution cancellation or sole-grocery loss was corroborated.

duplicate_screen.method: Read latest watch-ledger record; screened source publication and event dates plus previously flagged Provo/Utah closure duplication.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search results are not exhaustive, especially same-hour local agency notices not yet indexed. No findings does not establish no nationwide incident.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approvals, publication, primary production collector changes, schedule changes or disabling.
